summary: The paste handler rejects an over-limit multiline paste before calling renderRows, so existing saved rows are left intact and the browser default paste is prevented. The within-limit path still renders and focuses the pasted rows as before.

evidence: public/admin_projects.js lines 149-155 return after setting the over-limit status when next.length exceeds maxEntries, before renderRows can replace any rows.
public/admin_projects.js lines 215-216 call preventDefault whenever pasteRows returns true, including the overflow branch, so the rejected paste is not inserted into the focused input.
Skipping renderRows on overflow leaves a full group of 50 existing row inputs and saved values unchanged for the subsequent save.
